name: Flappin
summary:
Flappin takes the world’s favorite bird-flapping chaos and cranks it up for VR. You’re the wings now — literally! Pump your arms, weave through endless pipes, and fight gravity one frantic flap at a time.

Simple? Sure. Silly? Absolutely. Addictive? You bet. Every run dares you to go just a little farther, and every “almost made it” guarantees you’ll want to try again.
